prompts.name: isaac_newton.png
prompts.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Asset isaac_newton.png for a secondary-school physics textbook. Create a respectful historically informed painted bust portrait of Isaac Newton as a mature man: recognizable long wavy silver-grey hair reaching shoulders, clean-shaven face, long nose, thoughtful expression, dark late-seventeenth/early-eighteenth-century coat with a simple white shirt at the neck. Three-quarter view, head and shoulders, restrained classical oil-painting realism on a softly muted warm neutral background. No modern clothing, no apple, no equations, no props, no text, no border, no watermark. A new educational portrait illustration, not a claim to be an authentic historical painting. Portrait aspect ratio, clear facial detail readable at 400px wide.

prompts.name: inercialna_vztazna_sustava.png
prompts.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Landscape Slovak physics textbook illustration in clean softly shaded blue-orange style on white, two equal panels. Explain Galilean relativity from INSIDE a train carriage. Draw the same simple cutaway carriage interior and standing observer releasing an orange ball in both panels, one hand extended. Under the release point show exactly three ghost ball positions vertically aligned, progressing downward to the floor, and a vertical downward trajectory arrow. Both panels have IDENTICAL vertical trajectories relative to carriage. Left heading exactly 'Vlak v pokoji', right heading exactly 'Rovnomerný priamočiary pohyb'. Above left carriage small label 'v = 0'; above right carriage outside the interior a horizontal rightward blue arrow labelled 'v = konšt.'. Carriages on straight level rails. No diagonal or parabolic ball paths, no horizontal force on ball, no acceleration of train, no arrows that could be mistaken for ball motion except vertical downward ones. Both observers and balls comove with carriage initially. Natural anatomy, clear large labels, no clutter, no decorative scenery, no watermark. This is an idealized diagram of a dropped ball seen by an observer inside each carriage.

prompts.name: zmena_hybnosti.png
prompts.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create a clean landscape Slovak textbook infographic on white illustrating change of momentum at constant mass. Two equal side-by-side panels with identical small orange wheeled laboratory carts on horizontal track, both moving right. LEFT heading 'Pred zrýchlením', cart labelled 'm = 2 kg', above it blue right arrow labelled 'v₁ = 1 m/s', below it orange right arrow labelled 'p₁ = 2 kg·m/s'. RIGHT heading 'Po zrýchlení', cart same size labelled 'm = 2 kg', blue right arrow labelled 'v₂ = 3 m/s', orange right arrow labelled 'p₂ = 6 kg·m/s'. For each color, right-panel arrow length exactly three times left-panel arrow length. Both panels maintain same scale. Bottom centered clearly separated calculation exactly 'Δp = p₂ − p₁ = 4 kg·m/s'. All quantities collinear and positive to the right; no force arrows, no extra equations, no different masses. Crisp large readable labels with correct Slovak accents, restrained blue/orange, subtle shading on carts, ample white space, no watermark. This is a schematic example not a photograph.

prompts.name: druhy_newtonov_zakon.png
prompts.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Landscape Slovak school physics textbook illustration of Newton's second law with two horizontal rows on white. Two IDENTICAL orange wheeled laboratory carts, same size and mass label 'm = 2 kg', on frictionless horizontal tracks. TOP ROW: orange rightward resultant force arrow attached to cart, label 'F = 2 N'; separately ABOVE cart blue rightward acceleration arrow labelled 'a = 1 m/s²'. BOTTOM ROW: orange rightward resultant force arrow twice top orange arrow length labelled 'F = 4 N'; separately above cart blue rightward acceleration arrow twice top blue arrow length labelled 'a = 2 m/s²'. Precisely aligned rows, cart on left and arrows to right; no people or irrelevant equipment. Bottom statement exactly 'Rovnaká hmotnosť: dvojnásobná sila → dvojnásobné zrýchlenie'. Small centered formula 'F = ma'. Use the values exactly, acceleration superscript 2 legible. All forces and accelerations point right. Horizontal resultant forces only, no gravity or normal arrows, no motion trails or velocity arrows. Clean crisp vectorlike lines with gentle textbook shading, blue-orange palette, readable at 500px, no watermark.

prompts.name: akcia_a_reakcia.png
prompts.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Landscape Slovak physics textbook illustration of Newton's third law for a BALL AND HAND, on white background with soft textbook shading and crisp arrows. One central large orange ball at right, a natural open vertical human palm immediately left of the ball pressing horizontally against its leftmost surface, forearm extends to left. At contact, two equal-length thick collinear horizontal arrows point in opposite directions: BLUE arrow from contact toward LEFT into the hand, ORANGE arrow from contact toward RIGHT into the ball. The arrows represent forces on DIFFERENT bodies, never two forces on one body. Place labels away from drawing with no overlap: above left arrow 'Lopta pôsobí na ruku', above right arrow 'Ruka pôsobí na loptu'. Below the whole drawing exactly 'Rovnaká veľkosť, opačný smer. Každá sila pôsobí na iné teleso.' No gravity arrows, no supporting horizontal palm underneath, no floor, no formulas, no extra force arrows, no motion trails, no titles or watermarks. Force arrows must have equal length. Show clearly identifiable ball-hand contact and natural anatomy. The blue left-pointing arrow is the ball's force on the hand; the orange right-pointing arrow is the hand's force on the ball.
